name: Pile of Fireworks (5-6)
source: Pathfinder Society Quest #5: The Dragon who Stole Evoking Day
description: A pile of stolen and volatile fireworks.
disable: DC 21 Crafting check (trained), DC 19 Engineering-lore check (trained), or DC 19 Explosives-lore check (trained) to safely remove the lit firework or DC 21 Thievery check (trained) to remove the lit fuse from the firework.

offensiveAbilities.name: Light Fuse
offensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger The pile of fireworks takes acid or fire damage.

Effect The fuse of one of the fireworks begins to burn and the pile of fireworks enters initiative immediately before the triggering creature or effect.

offensiveAbilities.name: Explosive Blast
offensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger The pile of fireworks begins its turn.

Effect The pile of fireworks explodes, dealing 6d8 fire damage (DC 25 basic Reflex save) save to all creatures within 15 feet.
